name: droba
description: Droba: Nigeria's marketplace for pre-loved everything. Monorepo for the API, web app and shared types.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @droba/shared && npm run db:generate -w @droba/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @droba/shared && npm run build -w @droba/api && npm run build -w @droba/web
